question: Who among the following wrote the novel ‘Rangbhumi: The Arena of Life’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Munshi Premchand**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Munshi Pemchand** wrote the novel **‘Rangbhumi: The Arena of Life’**.
 
• **Rangbhoomi** (The Arena of Life) is a **Hindi language novel by Premchand **that features an idealist protagonist **inspired by Gandhian values**.
 
• In this novel of epic proportions set in **pre-Independence India**, Premchand treads the tricky ground of tensions between the rulers and the ruled.
 
• Capturing the travails and traumas of peasant society, **Rangbhumi celebrates the unassailable spirit of the common man**.
 
• **Rangbhumi** was a product of both **personal and political difficulties**.
 
• The original Hindi novel, **published in 1925**, was critically acclaimed for its strong characterization and realistic portrayal of the times.
 
• Some of the famous works of Munshi Premchand include - **Karmabhoomi, Kafan, Godan, Poos Ki Raat, Nirmala, Thakur Ka Kuan, Eidgah, Namak Ka Daroga, etc.**

 Abanindranath Tagore
 
 
**Abanindranath Tagore** was the principal artist and creator of the **"Indian Society of Oriental Art"**. 

 
His books **Rajkahini, Buro Angla, Nalak, and Khirer Putul** were landmarks in Bengali language children's literature and art.

 
 
 

 Mahatma Gandhi
 
 
Famous books written by Mahatma Gandhi are - **an Autobiography (The story of My Experiments with truth), Inspirational thoughts, The words of Gandhi, Hind Swaraj or Indian home rule, Third Class in Indian Railways, etc**.

 
 
 

 Rabindranath Tagore
 
 
**Rabindranath Tagore was born on 7 May 1861 and died on 7 August 1941.** 

 
He was an Indian polymath - **poet, writer, playwright, composer, philosopher, social reformer, and painter.**

 
Some of his famous works include - **Manasi (1890), Sonar Tari (1894), Gitanjali (1910), Gitimalya (1914**). etc.
